title: ContactHandover: Contact-Guided Robot-to-Human Object Handover
summary: A robot-to-human handover system that preserves human contact regions during robot grasping and optimizes delivery for human visibility, reachability, and comfort.

mechanisms.name: Human-contact-aware handover
mechanisms.description: Predicts human contact points, penalizes robot grasps that block them, and chooses a delivery pose that makes those contacts easier for the receiver to reach.
mechanisms.limitations: Robot-object handover on household objects does not establish assistive navigation, blind-user preferences, phone sensing, or safety.
